title: Account Change Resource
description: The stable identity of a changed resource: resource type, account ID, resource ID, and any parent IDs needed to disambiguate nested resources. Resource types are open for forward compatibility.

type.description: Open resource-type name such as account, media_buy, package, creative, creative_assignment, delivery_report, audience, event_source, catalog, account_financials, or invoice.

resource_id.description: Canonical identifier for the resource within its type. For an account change this equals account_id.

parent_ids.description: Additional canonical parent identifiers needed to repair a nested resource, for example media_buy_id and package_id for a creative assignment. Keys and values MUST NOT contain sensitive payload data.
